description: This file defines the CachingStream class, a stream decorator implementing caching for read bytes from a sequential stream, including methods for seeking, reading, writing, and closing streams.

classes.name: CachingStream
classes.description: A stream decorator class that caches bytes read from a remote stream, allowing for efficient seeking and reading operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CachingStream with a remote stream and an optional target stream for caching.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream, considering both the remote stream and the cache.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream based on offset and whence.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream, utilizing cache and remote stream as needed.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the cache stream, adjusting skip bytes for remote stream accordingly.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if both the cache and remote streams have reached EOF.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes both the remote and cache streams.

methods.name: cacheEntireStream
methods.description: Caches the entire remote stream into a temporary stream.
